speaker: Doctor
text: Welcome, I am Dr. Agent. To help me understand your condition, could you please tell me how many days ago you gave birth, and are you currently breastfeeding? Additionally, have you noticed any unusual or foul-smelling vaginal discharge?

speaker: Doctor
text: Thank you for that information. I see you are experiencing urinary frequency and decreased bowel sounds, which is concerning. Do you have any pain or burning when you urinate, and have you noticed any swelling or redness in the perineal or incision area?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Uterine tenderness. I also have Decreased bowel sounds, Increased frequency of urination, Fever.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned uterine tenderness and a fever, but I need to clarify the nature of the discharge. Are you passing any foul-smelling lochia, and have you had any chills or rigors associated with your fever?

speaker: Patient
text: Past medical history: Uncomplicated pregnancy leading up to a vaginal delivery. No significant past medical or surgical history. Social history: Does not smoke, drink alcohol, or use illicit drugs. Lives with her partner.

speaker: Doctor
text: You mentioned an 11-pound baby and prolonged labor, which increases the risk of uterine atony. Have you passed any large clots or tissue, and do you feel generally weak or dizzy? I would also like to check your current temperature and heart rate.
